standards.requirement_zh: 以资格预审公告为项目名称、三层范围、公告约面积、三处重点区、1.3—1.5 任务和成果语境的主控依据。
standards.requirement_en: Use the prequalification announcement as the controlling basis for the project name, three scales, stated approximate areas, three key areas, tasks 1.3–1.5 and deliverable context.
standards.professional_dimension: 规划统筹与任务边界 / Planning commission
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
三层范围工作框架
重点区域详细设计
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 正文按 43.6 km²统筹、11.4 km²总体和公告三重点区组织，但所有提交 polygon 明确保持 provisional；W1—W8、三重点区与双语图纸形成可审阅的任务映射，不把约面积升级为精确红线。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The narrative follows the 43.6 km² research scale, 11.4 km² overall-design scale and three announced key areas while keeping all submission polygons provisional. W1–W8, the three key areas and bilingual drawings provide reviewable task mapping without promoting approximate areas to precise redlines.

standards.requirement_zh: 响应十条共创原则、三大定位、五大功能、六项 Agent 任务、AI+场景、公共利益、品牌与长期运营，并保持可验证、可回退和不冒充授权。
standards.requirement_en: Respond to the ten co-creation principles, three positions, five functions, six agent tasks, AI+ scenarios, public interest, identity and long-term operations while remaining verifiable, reversible and non-authoritative.
standards.professional_dimension: 智能体共创、AI生态与运营 / Agent co-creation and operations
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 方案将 AI 限于结冰预测、人工复核后的工单辅助和低温测试；十四场景、八类使用者、三项产业验证、三地标和四次年度公开作业落实任务书，但均保留人工接管、普通服务和停止条件。
standards.evidence_summary_en: AI is limited to icing prediction, post-review work-order support and cold testing. Fourteen scenarios, eight user groups, three validation settings, three landmarks and four annual public operations answer the taskbook while retaining human control, non-AI service and stop conditions.

standards.requirement_zh: 城市设计应落实规划、统筹平面与立体空间、公共空间、建筑高度体量和城市风貌，并指导后续建筑设计。
standards.requirement_en: Urban design should implement planning requirements, coordinate horizontal and vertical space, public realm, building height/massing and city character, and guide later architectural design.
standards.professional_dimension: 城市设计、公共空间与风貌 / Urban design and character
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项 addressed 指已用“永久底盘—季节构件—测试件”和三重点区场地套合前原型作出城市设计响应，不表示工程深度合规。平/剖依赖、尺寸域、缺资料与下阶段交付已登记；当前没有真实比例套合图，高度体量仅为定性关系。
standards.evidence_summary_en: Addressed means an urban-design response is provided through the permanent-base/seasonal-component/test-piece framework and three pre-site-fit prototypes; it does not mean engineering-depth compliance. Plan/section dependencies, dimension domains, gaps and next outputs are registered. No true scaled fitted drawing exists, and massing remains qualitative.

standards.requirement_zh: 控规是规划许可与实施管理依据；本案必须区分已知控制、公开草案/项目状态、提交者建议和待补法定条件。
standards.requirement_en: Regulatory detailed planning underpins permission and implementation; this proposal must distinguish known controls, public draft/project status, submitter proposals and missing statutory conditions.
standards.professional_dimension: 控规衔接与实施管理 / Regulatory planning
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
三层范围工作框架
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 五态底图方法明确区分现状、已批、在建、规划和本案；FAR、建筑密度、道路面积/比例、红线、权属和管线保持 unknown，概念用地与包络均标记为非审定条件。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The five-state base-map method separates existing, approved, under-construction, planned and proposed conditions. FAR, density, road area/ratio, redlines, ownership and utilities remain unknown, and concept land use/envelopes are explicitly non-statutory.

standards.requirement_zh: 结构化用地表达应使用可校验的国土空间用地分类代码，同时避免把概念拓扑载体写成审定用地。
standards.requirement_en: Structured land use should use auditable territorial-spatial classification codes while avoiding claims that concept topology carriers are approved land use.
standards.professional_dimension: 用地分类与指标 / Land-use classification
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 四个 land_use feature 使用分类代码并组成临时边界内的概念拓扑分区；名称明确写“复核载体”，面积仅作几何自检，不是用地审批或供地指标。
standards.evidence_summary_en: Four coded land-use features form a conceptual topology partition inside the provisional boundary. They are labelled review carriers, and their areas are geometry checks rather than planning approval or land-supply controls.

standards.requirement_zh: 建筑工程设计文件深度须以可核验官方正文和适用阶段为准；当前包不得把概念包络、门厅与剖面原型宣称为施工图或报批建筑设计。
standards.requirement_en: Architectural document depth requires a verifiable official text and applicable stage; concept envelopes, vestibules and section prototypes are not construction or approval drawings.
standards.professional_dimension: 建筑专业文件深度 / Architectural document depth
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 仓库未取得该规定可核验官方正文，因此登记 data_gap；三处建筑仅为 conceptual envelope，建筑规模、总建面、FAR 与密度不作已知控制，正式深化需另行补齐标准与专业文件。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The repository lacks a verifiable official text, so this remains a data gap. The three buildings are concept envelopes; floor area, FAR and density are not known controls and later architectural documentation must be reviewed separately.

standards.requirement_zh: 生成式 AI 规则只按法定适用范围理解；本案应披露生成内容，并不得把路表预测、工单辅助或低温测试误写为已备案公共生成式 AI 服务。
standards.requirement_en: Generative-AI rules are read within their statutory scope; generated content is disclosed, and pavement prediction, work-order support or cold testing are not misrepresented as a filed public generative-AI service.
standards.professional_dimension: AI生成披露与适用范围 / AI disclosure and scope
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: agent.json、图注与版权声明披露 AI 文本/图像；V1—V3 评价卡声明当前无模型/数据集/结果，逐项规定最小输入、人工/规则基线、建议输出、人工确认、误报漏报/提前量/漂移/无效工单和停止退出，不推定备案、安全评估或许可。
standards.evidence_summary_en: agent.json, captions and the copyright statement disclose AI text/imagery. V1–V3 state that no model/dataset/result exists and specify minimum inputs, human/rule baselines, advisory output, human confirmation, false/missed alert, lead-time, drift, unnecessary-work, and stop/exit evaluation without implying filing, safety assessment or permission.

standards.requirement_zh: 无障碍环境应贯穿规划、建设和服务；第39条人工办理边界只按法律明确列举的公共服务场景解释，不泛化为所有公共空间。
standards.requirement_en: Accessibility should span planning, construction and service; Article 39 human-service duties are limited to expressly listed public-service settings and are not generalized to every public space.
standards.professional_dimension: 无障碍与人工替代 / Accessibility and human fallback
standards.legal_applicability_zh: 法律在适用场景具有强制性；本矩阵的 mandatory=false 仅表示它不是 site-package 五项 formal 主控标准之一。
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
standards.evidence_summary_zh: W2 把无障碍链与首清链重合，雪堆、工具和设备不得占用连续线；轮椅/盲杖共走仍待开展，100% 为设计目标而非现状绩效，且人工服务条款未被泛化。
standards.evidence_summary_en: W2 aligns the accessible route with the first-cleared route and excludes snow, tools and equipment from it. Wheelchair/cane co-walks remain pending, 100% is a design target rather than performance, and human-service duties are not generalized.

standards.requirement_zh: 传统服务方式与智能服务并行可作老年友好场景背景，但阶段性政策不写成 2026 年本地法定义务或已落实事实。
standards.requirement_en: Parallel traditional and smart services may inform age-friendly scenarios, but the time-bounded policy is not stated as a 2026 local legal duty or implementation fact.
standards.professional_dimension: 适老服务与数字包容 / Age-friendly inclusion
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 冬阳席、非消费暖身点、厕所饮水、人工问询和纸图回退服务老人及其他冬季脆弱使用者；这些是设计建议，不声称政策已在场地落实。
standards.evidence_summary_en: Winter-sun seating, non-commercial warm-up points, toilets/water, human enquiry and paper-map fallback serve older and other winter-vulnerable users. These are design proposals, not claimed implementation of the policy.

standards.requirement_zh: 步行和自行车环境应形成连续、安全、可达的网络；本案把雪脊、坡口、盲道、过街、骑行停车和清雪设备冲突纳入冬季断面。
standards.requirement_en: Walking and cycling environments should be continuous, safe and accessible; winter sections must address snow ridges, kerb ramps, tactile paving, crossings, cycle parking and clearing-equipment conflicts.
standards.professional_dimension: 步行、自行车与无障碍 / Walking and cycling
standards.professional_applicability_zh: 作为北京地方专业标准按具体道路和项目条件核验适用条款。
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项仅在方法/检查表层面 addressed：五条候选链与 W2 先锁定无障碍、排水和消防连续线，再安排设备、储雪、停车与装卸；当前没有实测断面或净宽合规结论，坡度、净宽和道路等级均待测绘套合。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed only at method/checklist level: five candidate routes and W2 protect accessible, drainage and fire-continuity lines before equipment, storage, parking and loading. There is no surveyed-section or clear-width compliance conclusion; slopes, widths and road class await survey fit.

standards.requirement_zh: 站城一体化应统筹站口、换乘、慢行、公共空间和运营；本案需在风雪、入口带水和回冻条件下保持大钟寺连续换乘。
standards.requirement_en: Station-city integration coordinates entrances, interchange, active travel, public space and operations; Dazhongsi interchange continuity must persist under wind/snow, tracked-in water and refreeze.
standards.professional_dimension: 站城一体化与换乘 / Station-city integration
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项仅在站城关系原型层面 addressed：W8、ROUTE-05 和回冻点表达雪—水—入口—换乘的待套合顺序，并登记所缺站口、客流、风雪、排水和消防资料；300米/5分钟只作专业参考，不声称连廊、地下工程或真实断面获批。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed only as a station-city relational prototype: W8, ROUTE-05 and refreeze points define a snow–water–entrance–interchange order pending fit and register missing entrance, flow, wind/snow, drainage and fire data. The 300 m/5 min network is reference only; no link, underground work or real section is approved.

standards.requirement_zh: 《超低能耗公共建筑设计标准》只作为室外风环境、热工与日照模拟方法的后续参照；建筑类型、适用范围和能耗资料未定时不得外推为全线强制或已合规。
standards.requirement_en: The ultra-low-energy public-building standard is used only as a later method reference for outdoor wind, thermal and solar analysis; unresolved building type, scope and energy data prevent corridor-wide mandatory or compliance claims.
standards.professional_dimension: 建筑风热日照与能耗 / Building wind, thermal, solar and energy
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项仅在模拟方法与深化清单层面 addressed：冬至约26.58°和≥2小时冬阳分别是筛查量/设计目标；当前没有风热日照或能耗模型结果。AI原点须以实测体量做冬季门厅与夏季过热联合复核，不声称 DB11/T 2240 全线适用或合规。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed only at simulation-method and development-checklist level. Approximate 26.58° and ≥2 h are screening input/design target, and no wind, thermal, solar or energy-model result exists. AI Origin requires surveyed winter-vestibule/summer-overheating review; no corridor-wide applicability or compliance is claimed.

standards.requirement_zh: 蓝绿与雨洪系统应保护生态、组织源头与排水关系；冬季必须把洁净雪、含盐雪、普通雨水和设备清洗水分流。
standards.requirement_en: Blue-green and stormwater systems should protect ecology and organize source/drainage relationships; clean snow, salt-laden snow, ordinary rainwater and equipment washwater must be separated in winter.
standards.professional_dimension: 蓝绿、排水与融雪水 / Blue-green and meltwater
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项在污染防控关系和后续核算清单层面 addressed：四个搜索区、W3 与回冻点组织洁净/含盐分流、融水和夜查；没有地形、管底、汇水区、土壤或雪量数据，因此不声称海绵/排水容量，储雪与融水线仍是搜索关系。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed at pollution-control relationship and future-calculation checklist level. Four search areas, W3 and refreeze points organize clean/salt separation, meltwater and night checks. Without terrain, pipe invert, catchment, soil or snowfall data, no sponge/drainage capacity is claimed and storage/meltwater lines remain search relationships.

standards.requirement_zh: 文物保护优先，保护范围和建控地带内的新增构件、排水、防滑和材料处理必须最小干预、可逆并经主管部门审查。
standards.requirement_en: Heritage protection prevails; new components, drainage, slip resistance and material treatment within protection/control zones must be minimal, reversible and reviewed by the competent authority.
standards.professional_dimension: 铁路遗产保护 / Railway heritage
standards.legal_applicability_zh: 法律在适用范围内具有强制性；本矩阵 mandatory=false 仅表示不是 site-package 五项 formal 主控标准。
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项在禁止事项和审查门槛层面 addressed，而非完成文保设计：W7 只提出病害巡查、低扰动防滑和可逆排水关系；本包无核验文保 polygon/本体调查，不附着本体，也不把未鉴定构件写成遗存。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed through prohibitions and review gates, not a completed heritage design. W7 only proposes inspection, low-impact slip resistance and reversible drainage relationships. No verified heritage polygon/fabric survey exists; nothing attaches to protected fabric and unverified objects are not called relics.

standards.requirement_zh: 适用责任地段应按北京扫雪铲冰规则组织时限、机械/人工、雪堆位置和含融雪剂冰雪隔离；不得把特定道路条款泛化为全部场地。
standards.requirement_en: Applicable responsibility areas should follow Beijing snow-clearing rules for timing, mechanical/manual work, snow placement and salt-snow isolation, without generalizing specific road duties to every site.
standards.professional_dimension: 扫雪铲冰与冬季运营 / Snow operations
standards.legal_applicability_zh: 管理规定在适用责任地段具有约束力；2024试点方案作为作业方法背景。
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本项在规则转译和作业原型层面 addressed，不表示责任段已签认或清雪能力已验证。五候选链、W2/W3、四回冻点形成责任—设备—绕行—储雪—复核闭环；7:30/10:00 只在确认适用地段引用，储雪位仍待容量核算与联合核准。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This item is addressed as rule translation and an operations prototype, not as signed responsibility segments or proven clearing capacity. Five routes, W2/W3 and four refreeze points form the loop. The 07:30/10:00 times apply only after applicability is confirmed, and storage requires capacity calculation and joint approval.

standards.requirement_zh: 城市更新应以保留利用提升为主，统筹设施、公共空间、无障碍、历史文化、绿色韧性、实施主体和全生命周期运营。
standards.requirement_en: Urban renewal prioritizes retention and improvement while coordinating infrastructure, public realm, accessibility, heritage, green resilience, implementing entities and life-cycle operations.
standards.professional_dimension: 城市更新实施 / Urban renewal implementation
standards.legal_applicability_zh: 条例适用于北京城市更新活动；本案尚未成为经审查实施方案。
proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 方案按“门厅先改、首层再用、院落先试、新建最后”组织留改拆，并以0—6、6—18、18—60月三阶段推进；所有实施主体、权属、资金、许可和运营仍待确认。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The retain/renovate/demolish sequence is vestibule first, ground-floor reuse next, courtyard testing before new build, followed by 0–6, 6–18 and 18–60 month phases. Entities, ownership, funding, permits and operations remain unresolved.
